_README: Facts SSOT. Follows HARNESS.md. Only status:VERIFIED facts render. All numbers/contacts/rules must be grounded here. No invented estimates. VOLATILE facts must show source + verified date + confirm link. claim/notes are the ENGLISH (base-language) display text; translations for other locales live in messages/<locale>.json under `facts`.

facts.claim: Visa-free nationals can enter Korea without K-ETA until 2026-12-31. The e-Arrival Card is still required. Travelers aged 17 and under or 65 and over are exempt from K-ETA.
facts.notes: Sources differ on the number of exempt countries (22 vs 67). Confirm the current country list at the official site; check your own case with a consulate.

facts.claim: Korea's fire and emergency medical (ambulance) number is 119.
The Korea Tourism Organization's travel help, interpretation and complaint line is 1330 (24 hours, multilingual).
AREX Express train: non-stop between Incheon Airport and Seoul Station. One-way fare and travel time below.
facts.notes: Official Seoul guide states KRW 9,500. Some 2026 third-party sources cite KRW 11,000–13,000 — a conflict. Always confirm the current fare at arex.or.kr.

facts.claim: AREX all-stop train: reaches Seoul Station in under 60 minutes. One-way fare below.
facts.notes: T-money accepted. Confirm the latest fare at arex.or.kr.

facts.claim: Incheon Airport limousine bus: about 60–80 minutes to Seoul. Fare range below.
facts.notes: Varies by route and destination; time depends on traffic.

facts.claim: T-money cards are sold and recharged at convenience stores nationwide (CU, GS25, 7-Eleven, Emart24) and at subway station machines.

value.stores: CU, GS25, 7-Eleven, Emart24, subway station machines

facts.notes: Works on subway, bus, taxi and at convenience stores.

facts.claim: T-money basic card price and refund policy.
facts.notes: Varies by store and design. The card fee itself is non-refundable (only the remaining balance is refundable). Confirm at the official t-money.co.kr.

facts.claim: The best times to visit are spring (Mar–May) and autumn (Sep–Nov). Summer (Jun–Aug) is hot and humid with a monsoon; winter is cold and dry (Seoul averages about -2°C).
facts.source_name: General climate info / multiple travel guides
facts.notes: General seasonal characteristics. Cherry-blossom and fall-foliage dates shift each year.

facts.claim: Tipping is not customary in Korea; you don't need to tip at restaurants or in taxis.
facts.notes: Some luxury hotels may add a service charge, but generally no tip is expected.
Cards are widely accepted; cash is handy for small vendors and traditional markets.

facts.claim: Many nationalities can enter visa-free for tourism (length varies by country: 30/60/90 days).
facts.source_name: HiKorea (MOJ) / Visa policy of South Korea
facts.notes: Varies by country — do not generalize. Provide a per-country confirmation link in the UI.
